assertions.evidence: In src/incident-urgency.js the request defines questions.urgency = { type: "score", ... criteria: URGENCY_CRITERIA } where URGENCY_CRITERIA is an ordered array of five levels; the test also asserts request.questions.urgency.type === "score".
parseDecisionResponse sets urgency from code via urgency: integerUrgency(answer.score) and integerUrgency rounds the model’s score (+1) to 1–5; no second call or model-generated integer is used.

The POST body sets state: { incident_report: text, affected_service: service }, sending report text and service as separate named fields; the test checks request.state.affected_service === "checkout".
